title: CARE Hospitals, HITEC City awarded prestigious JCI accreditation
summary: Global recognition validates excellence in patient safety, clinical quality and healthcare outcomes

contentHtml:
Global recognition validates excellence in patient safety, clinical quality and healthcare outcomes

CARE Hospitals, HITEC City has achieved accreditation from the Joint Commission International (JCI), one of the world’s most respected healthcare accreditation bodies, placing it among a select group of hospitals recognized for meeting internationally benchmarked standards of patient safety, quality, and clinical excellence.

For patients, the accreditation provides assurance that care is delivered through robust, standardized systems designed to enhance safety, improve clinical outcomes, strengthen infection prevention practices, and ensure a consistently high-quality healthcare experience aligned with global best practices.

Widely regarded as the gold standard in healthcare accreditation, JCI evaluates hospitals against rigorous international standards across key areas including patient care, clinical protocols, medication management, quality governance, infection prevention and control, and patient safety.

The achievement follows a comprehensive assessment of the hospital’s clinical and operational practices and reflects the collective efforts of its doctors, nurses, caregivers, and support teams in building a culture where quality, safety, and continuous improvement remain central to every patient interaction.

Speaking on the achievement, Dr Pawan Kumar, CEO, CARE Hospitals, said, “Patients place immense trust in us during some of the most important and vulnerable moments of their lives. JCI accreditation validates that the systems, processes, and culture behind every patient interaction at CARE Hospitals, HITEC City meet globally benchmarked standards of safety and quality. More importantly, it reflects our commitment to continuously improve, innovate, and deliver the highest standards of care. As one of India’s leading healthcare networks, we remain focused on building trust through clinical excellence, patient-centricity, and outcomes that matter.”

Nilesh Gupta, Regional CEO, CARE Hospitals, said, “This achievement is the result of years of commitment, collaboration, and unwavering focus from our doctors, nurses, clinical teams, and support staff. JCI accreditation is not just a recognition of our processes; it is a reflection of our people and their dedication to delivering safe, compassionate, and world-class care every day.”

This milestone further strengthens CARE Hospitals’ position as a trusted destination for advanced healthcare and marks another important step in its journey to build one of India’s most trusted healthcare networks.

As CARE Hospitals celebrates this achievement, it remains focused on advancing clinical excellence, enhancing patient experience, and making safe, trusted, and high-quality healthcare accessible to the communities it serves.
